metadata.description: RAN3 Phase-2 CQ 22개 — Resolution/Moderator 역할 분석 검증

sort_rules.CQ1: Meeting 번호 DESC, Agenda ASC, Sequence ASC
sort_rules.CQ6: Meeting 번호 DESC (최신 먼저), 같은 번호는 Meeting 이름 DESC

questions.question: RAN3#121 회의에서 합의된 Agreement 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN3#121'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, ai.agendaNumber ORDER BY ai.agendaNumber, a.sequence LIMIT 15

questions.question: RAN3#94 회의에서 도출된 Conclusion 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN3#94'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content, ai.agendaNumber, c.hasConsensus ORDER BY ai.agendaNumber, c.sequence LIMIT 15

questions.question: RAN3#112 회의의 Working Assumption 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (w:WorkingAssumption)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN3#112'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN w.resolutionId, w.content, ai.agendaNumber ORDER BY ai.agendaNumber, w.sequence LIMIT 15

questions.question: Agenda 8.1의 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.1'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS types, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r.sequence LIMIT 15

questions.question: Rel-18 관련 Resolution 목록은? (references → Tdoc → targetRelease)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS types, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: 38.423 Spec을 변경하는 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS types, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum ORDER BY mNum DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: 특정 Work Item의 Resolution 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN wi.workItemCode AS wi, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Resolution이 가장 많은 Agenda Item Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN ai.agendaNumber, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Tdoc이 어떤 Resolution으로 이어졌나? (Resolution 이 가장 많이 참조한 Tdoc)
questions.cypher: MATCH (:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t0:Tdoc) WITH t0, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC, t0.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t0) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t0.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r.resolutionId ASC

questions.question: 특정 Resolution이 참조한 Tdoc 목록은? (Tdoc 을 가장 많이 참조한 Resolution)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r0:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc) MATCH (r0)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH r0, m, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC, m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r0.resolutionId ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (r0)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) RETURN r0.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, t.tdocNumber, t.title ORDER BY t.tdocNumber DESC

questions.question: 특정 Resolution 본문에서 Tdoc 참조를 확인 (content 속성)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution) WHERE r.content IS NOT NULL AND r.content =~ '.*R3-.*' RETURN r.resolutionId, r.content ORDER BY r.resolutionId LIMIT 5

questions.question: 특정 Tdoc이 어떤 Spec에 반영됐나?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN s.specNumber, count(DISTINCT t) AS tdocCnt ORDER BY tdocCnt DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: ZTE의 Tdoc이 Resolution으로 이어진 비율은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'ZTE'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t) WITH count(DISTINCT t) AS totalTdocs, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r IS NOT NULL THEN t END) AS resolutionLinkedTdocs, count(DISTINCT r) AS linkingResolutions RETURN totalTdocs, resolutionLinkedTdocs, linkingResolutions, round(100.0 * resolutionLinkedTdocs / totalTdocs, 2) AS linkedRate

questions.question: 회사별 Resolution 기여도 Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 38.423 Spec의 주요 contributor 순위는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'}) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: ZTE와 Huawei의 Resolution 기여도 비교
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE c.companyName IN ['ZTE', 'Huawei'] RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

questions.question: Agenda 8.1의 Moderator는 누구(어느 회사)인가?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Summary)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.1'}) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company) MATCH (s)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN c.companyName, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, count(s) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: ZTE가 Moderator를 맡은 Agenda Item 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Summary)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'ZTE'}) MATCH (s)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) MATCH (s)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN ai.agendaNumber, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, ai.agendaNumber LIMIT 15

questions.question: 회사별 Moderator 담당 비율 Top 10
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Summary)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(s) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Agenda 8.1(New Incoming LSs)의 Resolution 수 추이는? (최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.1'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

questions.question: ZTE의 기여율 변화 추이는? (회의별 Tdoc 이 이어진 Resolution 중 ZTE 기고가 이어진 비율, 최신 회의부터)
questions.cypher: MATCH (r2:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'ZTE'}) MATCH (r2)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH c, m, count(DISTINCT r2) AS companyCount MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH c, m, companyCount, count(DISTINCT r) AS total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS { (r)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc) } THEN r END) AS linked RETURN c.companyName AS company, m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, companyCount, linked, total, round(100.0 * companyCount / linked, 1) AS shareOfLinked ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

questions.question: ZTE의 Moderator 담당 추이는? (최신 회의부터) — RAN3 고유 CQ
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Summary)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'ZTE'}) MATCH (s)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(s) AS cnt ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC
